<Style & frame constraints - apply to the whole shot, every second of it: cinematic 9:16 vertical framing, ARRI Alexa look, 50 mm spherical lens, locked-off camera at chest height, the woman standing centre of frame, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, photorealistic live-action footage, warm ceiling light from above, the red pouch catching a soft warm rim, the doorway behind glowing, true-to-life East Asian skin with visible pores, fine lines and a matte finish, neutral white balance, muted naturalistic colour, gentle filmic contrast with a soft highlight roll-off.
